name: component-start-tag-unmatched-brace
description: A brace no brace closes inside a start tag hides no later block. In a .vue file it is a character of an attribute name or value and the tag ends at the first >. In a .svelte or .astro file the braced value ends at the first > or before a <script start tag that begins a line, whichever comes first. Each block after such a tag is read, so the exports its imports name are used.
